locator.section: Ordo Missae, Gloria Patri through Amen

entries.claim: The full Gloria Patri supplies w037–w056 after the proper cue. The print has semper: et; the selected house-expanded transcript declares its comma instead. The altar-prayer speaker markers do not determine this Introit’s speaker.

locator.section: Proper antiphon and psalm with abbreviated Gloria Patri and Exaudi cues; complete doxology and reprise are separate declared expansions

entries.claim: This proper-page locus prints the antiphon and psalm verse and cues for Gloria Patri and repetition, not the entire expanded Introit. The source formula and repetition rubric are separately identified.

RG 427 prescribes antiphon, psalm verse, Gloria Patri and repeated antiphon. It supports the declared p. 347 cue expansion and repetition w057–w084 of w001–w028, not a second full printing on the proper page.
